title: A pre-registered catch-anchored margin threshold for chroma_vk and a linear in-object illuminant arm, on a freshly generated holdout
semantics: Colour decisions only; localization is the existing grayscale Session search, identical for every method. Adds the opt-in chroma_vk job key reference_model (constant = round 46, default; linear = new arm). Every existing runner output (gray_ncc, rgb_ncc, chroma, and chroma_vk with the constant model) is unchanged; GUI, core and research defaults are unchanged whatever the result.
base: Branch claude/round47-chroma-margin: main c1e3b03 (round 45) with round 46 (claude/round46-illum-chroma, head 57887db) merged as ce057fe. Round 46 is not on main; it lands with this branch.
implementation_note: Three commits on ce057fe: b879690 adds ReferenceModel::Linear to experiments/color_illuminant.{hpp,cpp}, the reference_model runner key, native and runner contract tests, seed options for testbed_blender_render.py (defaults unchanged), tools/benchmark_chroma_margin.py and tests/test_chroma_margin_harness.py; 172f86a pins the end size in a native test and moves the verdict, catch and mask checks into tested functions; 190973e hardens three tests after the first mutant run. The frozen candidate runner is build/stage47-release (Release, GUI+experiments+OpenCV, target fpm_color_verify_runner) built from git archive 190973e; the base runner is build/stage47-base built the same way from git archive ce057fe. SHA-256: candidate 0a6b3a26232f282fd1b2beda9df524d082b9a5fb536de140098cce3ea4600b63, base e2be71b46bf807592ce389fd911da2e05440364b05094154553d5456a6142f85 (the run manifest records them again and checks them before and after the run).
question: Q1 (gated): with a threshold fixed from the label artwork alone (half the smallest noise-free region chroma distance of a change the check must catch, DeltaE00 = 4), does chroma_vk (object reference, constant model, rank policy, region distance) accept the decided same-colour objects and reject every gated different-colour object (isogray included) under the round-46 held-out lighting, on a holdout regenerated with never-used layout, noise, background and render seeds, while the round-46 calibration lighting confirms a 2x same-colour margin?

Q2 (gated, separate preference): does the linear reference model (illuminant slopes from the reference panel's outer thirds per template axis, extrapolated to every colour sample) pass the same checks with the same thresholds, and give smaller same-colour residuals than the constant model under the in-object gradients (spot_warm, Blender mixed)?

Q3 (reported): end-to-end acceptance with abstention counted as not accepted (round-46 definition), abstention per condition, the noise-only Rayleigh rule and round 46's p95 rule on the same objects, the other arms, DeltaE 2, lightness+, exposure_bright and the fresh calibration-lighting scenes.

data.calibration: round 46's calibration lighting only: build/testbed-v1 of the main checkout, scenes syn_{red,teal}_{neutral,exposure_dark,wb_cool,shading} and bl_rgb_white (9 scenes). Round 46's held-out v1 scenes are never read.
data.holdout: a fresh test-bed regenerated by `benchmark_chroma_margin.py holdout` into build/stage47-holdout: testbed_generate textures (artwork seed unchanged; every texture file must be byte-identical to v1) and synthetic scenes (2 families x 8 conditions, 32 objects each) with new layout, noise and background seeds, plus bl_rgb_white, bl_rgb_warm3200 and bl_rgb_mixed (12 objects each, same texture mix) with new Cycles, texture-order and pose seeds. Every input is checked against the holdout's final/manifest.json before any worker runs.
data.splits: calibration = the 9 v1 scenes; holdout = fresh wb_warm, exposure_bright, spot_warm, noise_jpeg (both families), warm3200, mixed (10 scenes); fresh_calibration = fresh neutral, exposure_dark, wb_cool, shading (both families), white (9 scenes): reported only, never calibrates or gates anything
data.templates: test-bed v1 templates for every scene (syn_{family}_template.png, final/bl_rgb_reference_template.png): the template is the learned model; the regenerated templates are not used
data.seed_note: testbed_generate derives the per-condition noise seeds noise+0..7 and the template seed noise+99; the chosen bases keep every derived seed disjoint from every other seed listed here
data.used_seeds_note: test-bed v1 (layout, noise, background, Cycles and every Blender layout seed), the round-46 smoke and the round-47 smoke; the holdout seeds must differ from all of them. The artwork seed 2026102401 is reused on purpose (the label artwork stays the same)
data.labels: colour labels are defined once per texture under the neutral reference light (TESTBED_V1); GT is read only by the summarize step

localization.search: testbed_evaluate.SEARCH (Metal search and refinement, angle 180, score .65, proposal .5, min_area 256, cpu_threads 8, pose_resident_mode 0, fine_ncc_mode 2, fused, angle reuse) with limit 64; synthetic scales [.85,1,1.15], Blender [.9,1,1.1] (as round 46)
localization.rule: colour metrics use found objects only; localization TP/FP/FN are reported per scene, separately from colour decisions; false-positive detections are reported with their decisions but have no colour label; a localization miss is not a colour failure and is not gated

masks.rule: the stage-46 rule (template annotations from testbed_generate.capsule_texture: colour = family colour, reference = off-white panel (236,234,226), each eroded 5x5); the files must be byte-identical to stage 46's

methods.note: one fresh runner process per scene x method, warmups 0, repeats 1 (exact_repeat checks determinism); chroma options .04 / .03 / .95; chroma_vk saturation_level 255, max_reference_clip_fraction .45, min_reference_fraction .5 (all as round 46)
methods.vk_object: chroma_vk, object reference, constant model, rank policy (round 46 primary)
methods.vk_object_none: chroma_vk, object reference, constant model, no saturation handling (round 46 ablation; also gives the uncorrected control)
methods.card_gray: chroma_vk, source_rect 18% gray card, rank (synthetic only; global-reference control)
methods.vk_linear: chroma_vk, object reference, LINEAR model, rank policy (new arm)
methods.base_identity: every method except vk_linear also runs on the base runner; scores and search matches must be identical

linear_model.definition: template reference pixels are ranked by template u and, separately, by template v (ties in raster order); the lowest and highest thirds are the two ends per axis. Each end and the whole reference are estimated like round 46 (per-channel median of nearest source pixels, same clip policy and limits); every end must be usable or the object abstains (status 3). Each median is placed at the median template (u, v) of the samples behind it, and slope_u, slope_v solve both end pairs jointly (W_hi - W_lo = slope_u du + slope_v dv for the u pair and the v pair; each pair must be ordered along its own axis and the determinant positive, else abstain); W(u,v) = W_all + slope_u (u - u_all) + slope_v (v - v_all), and each colour sample is corrected by T / W(u,v) with T the template's whole-reference median. A non-positive W at any valid colour sample abstains.
linear_model.geometry: the colour field (template x 5-67 after erosion) lies entirely left of the panel (x 75-122), so the u slope is extrapolated over about one panel width; the v range of field and panel coincide
linear_model.expected_cost: the extrapolation amplifies reference noise; this is a measured trade-off, not tuned

arms.rule: dissimilarity (larger = more different). NCC: 1 - score (score -2 abstains). Chroma: the distance; -1 abstains (status != 0)

thresholds.primary_rule: catch-anchored, symmetric 2x margin, artwork only: d_catch(family) = min of the noise-free region chroma distance (linear sRGB chromaticity distance / sqrt 2, the chroma_vk formula) between the family's artwork colour and (a) every in-gamut colour at CIEDE2000 = 4 on the constant-L* circle around it (1 degree steps, unrounded) and (b) every gated artwork variant (hue+, hue-, chroma-, isogray0, isogray90 at target DeltaE >= 4, 8-bit as testbed_generate renders them); tau = d_catch / 2; bl_red uses the red artwork. Applied unchanged to every chromaticity arm, every lighting and both models; NCC arms have no catch threshold. No scene pixel enters tau; the values below were computed (benchmark_chroma_margin.py thresholds) before any scene of this round was evaluated, and summarize recomputes them and fails integrity if they differ.

syn_red.binding: constant-L* circle at 118 degrees, distance 0.01631504666311583 (closest gated variant hue+ 4: 0.017290584745818093)

syn_teal.binding: artwork variant isogray0 4, distance 0.029402122290702555 (constant-L* circle minimum 0.031230770488168934 at 193 degrees)

thresholds.feasibility: calibration lighting is used only here and for the secondary rules: F1 every decided calibration same-colour value <= tau/2 (a 2x same-colour margin), F2 calibration gated different-colour rejection >= .95, per group
thresholds.decision: accepted = not abstained and dissimilarity <= tau (inclusive); abstention is never an acceptance; for different colours it counts as not accepted

secondary.rayleigh: noise-only rule, per arm and group from decided calibration same-colour values: s = sqrt(mean(d^2)/2), tau = s sqrt(-2 ln 1e-3) (a Rayleigh false rejection of 1e-3); not for NCC arms
secondary.p95: round 46's rule (numpy percentile 95 of decided calibration same-colour values), for comparison with round 46
secondary.role: reported with the same checks; they decide nothing

integrity: search matches identical across all methods of a scene
every method except vk_linear equals the base runner (scores and search matches)
no GT key or GT path in any job
input, job and result SHA-256 unchanged; run complete; binaries unchanged
holdout record unchanged; synthetic and Blender seeds equal holdout_seeds; no holdout seed in used_seeds and no duplicate; every texture byte-identical to v1
gates.F: primary arm, catch rule, calibration split: F1 per group (syn_red n=40, syn_teal n=40, bl_red n=4 when all found) max decided same-colour <= tau/2; F2 per group gated different-colour rejection >= .95
gates.H1: primary arm, catch rule, fresh synthetic holdout, per condition wb_warm, spot_warm, noise_jpeg pooled over both families: H1a decided same-colour acceptance >= .90 with at least 5 decided objects (fewer fails); H1b rejection >= .95 over hue+, hue-, chroma-, isogray0, isogray90 at DeltaE >= 4 (n = 30); H1c isogray0/isogray90 DeltaE >= 4 pooled over the three conditions >= .95 (n = 36)
gates.H2: primary arm, catch rule, fresh Blender warm3200 and mixed: H2a every decided same-colour object accepted, at least 2 decided of 4; H2b all 7 gated different-colour objects rejected
gates.decided: decided = found and not abstained. Abstention (clipped or out-of-image reference, missing colour support) is a review output of the verifier, reported per condition and in the end-to-end table, never hidden: the threshold rule cannot repair a clipped reference, so Q1 is gated on decided objects with a coverage floor
gates.not_gated: lightness+ (a chromaticity statistic removes intensity by construction), DeltaE 2 (at the threshold by construction: the red hue+/- DeltaE 2 variants sit at 0.0082 against tau 0.0082), exposure_bright (the panel clips by design), fresh_calibration scenes, every secondary rule and arm, AUC, and end-to-end acceptance

gradient_arm.checks: vk_linear_region under the catch rule with the same F, H1 and H2 checks
gradient_arm.comparison: same-colour holdout objects decided by both vk_region and vk_linear_region in spot_warm (both families) and Blender mixed: one-sided exact sign test that the linear residual is smaller (ties excluded), alpha .05; also reported per holdout condition with the median ratio linear/constant
gradient_arm.preference: vk_linear_region is preferred over vk_region only if integrity holds, all of its F/H1/H2 checks pass and the sign test is significant; otherwise the constant model stays the primary

decision.recommended: the catch rule on vk_region becomes the research threshold rule for chroma_vk same-colour checks (abstention as a review output) only if every integrity gate and every F, H1 and H2 check passes; otherwise it is not recommended and every failed check is listed
decision.defaults: no default changes in any outcome; reference_model defaults to constant; no change to chroma, rgb_ncc or gray_ncc

predictions: P1 F1 and F2 pass for every group: calibration residuals of the primary arm sit far below tau/2
P2 wb_warm and noise_jpeg: every decided same-colour object accepted by the primary arm under the catch rule
P3 spot_warm: the primary arm passes H1a on decided objects, with the smallest margin of the gated synthetic cells (the in-object gradient grows towards the spot)
P4 spot_warm end-to-end acceptance stays below .90 because objects near the spot centre abstain (clipped red panel); exposure_bright abstains on (nearly) every object
P5 H1b, H1c and H2b pass: no gated different-colour object is accepted, isogray included

P6 DeltaE 2 hue+/- red objects are accepted roughly half the time (their noise-free distance equals tau); red lightness+ at DeltaE 4 (0.020) is rejected, teal lightness+ at DeltaE 4 (0.016 against 0.0147) is mostly rejected
P7 the Rayleigh rule fails H1a in noise_jpeg and spot_warm (calibration noise contains neither compression nor gradients); the p95 rule fails as in round 46

P8 the linear arm lowers same-colour residuals in spot_warm and Blender mixed (sign test significant) but raises them in uniform conditions (wb_warm, noise_jpeg, fresh neutral) because the extrapolation amplifies reference noise; it abstains at least as often as the constant arm in spot_warm
P9 Blender warm3200 and mixed: every decided same-colour object accepted by both arms
pre_registration_disclosure: Before this protocol the author had read round 46's report, protocol, decision file and its post-hoc diagnostics, including held-out numbers: same-colour maximum 0.0002-0.0061 in non-abstained held-out cells, nearest gated different colour 0.017 (red) / 0.029 (teal), DeltaE 2 at 0.008 / 0.013, JPEG and spot medians, and the spot geometry (objects within 1.24 sigma abstain). The predictions use this knowledge. The new holdout's layout, noise and render realizations had not been generated when this protocol was written.

The rule's form (half of the smallest must-catch distance, artwork only; calibration only for a tau/2 feasibility check; secondary Rayleigh and p95; gates on decided objects with abstention reported) was written to the session's shared notes at 2026-10-25T15:41Z before its numerical value was computed. The values (red 0.00816, teal 0.01470) were then computed from the artwork and are frozen above.

The catch rule uses the gated artwork variants (part (b)) because for teal the isogray0 DeltaE 4 variant is closer than the constant-L* circle minimum; this was seen while computing the values and is the reason part (b) is in the committed form.

The linear model's details were fixed while writing its native unit test, with no evaluation data involved: outer thirds; each end placed at the median coordinate rather than the centroid (a centroid biases the slope when an end's columns have unequal counts); and a joint solve of both end pairs, after a per-axis version failed the v-gradient unit test because rank ties left the u ends unbalanced in v (that failure was first hidden by a stale test binary). The first smoke ran on the per-axis version; the smoke was repeated on the final code.

Implementation smoke (plumbing only, seen, not evidence): `holdout` with smoke_seeds into build/stage47-smoke-holdout (Blender included), then scenes v1/syn_red_neutral, r47/syn_teal_spot_warm and r47/bl_rgb_mixed on the development and base runners, and summarize; run twice (build/stage47-smoke on the per-axis linear model, build/stage47-smoke2 on the final code). Inspected only: integrity failures (exactly the three expected seed gates, because smoke seeds differ from holdout_seeds: a positive control), localization 32/0/0, 32/0/0 and 12/0/0, statuses and finiteness. Seen: on the smoke teal spot_warm scene 18 of 32 objects were status 3 for both vk_object and vk_linear (all objects, both colour classes; per-class counts not looked at); every other smoke object was status 0. Distances, thresholds checks and decisions were not inspected. Nothing in the method, thresholds, gates or predictions changed after the smoke.

Blender check before this protocol: the seed options leave the v1 render unchanged (bl_rgb_white re-rendered with the default seeds by the edited and by the original script decodes to the same pixels as v1; the PNG files differ only in metadata, so file hashes are not reproducible across renders and the holdout is checked against its own manifest).

Mutation testing before this protocol: 20 compiled mutants (16 of the linear model in color_illuminant.cpp, 4 of the runner key) and 32 harness mutants. On the first run (implementation 172f86a) R4 (chroma accepting reference_model) and T13/T20 (gates and the paired comparison filtering by condition name, equivalent under the real split definition) survived; 190973e hardened the three tests, and the rerun on 190973e killed every mutant. Both runs are logged in validation-logs.

Split, thresholds (frozen values above), targets, decided minimums, arms, masks, seeds and every chroma_vk parameter were fixed before any evaluation run; the holdout was generated only after this protocol was committed.

evidence.raw: build/stage47-margin (masks, run manifest, jobs, stderr, results) and build/stage47-holdout (the fresh test-bed) archived with SHA-256 manifests, each archive below 100 MB
evidence.validation: independent recount that does not import the harness, a replay of every candidate job on a runner rebuilt from source-snapshot.tar.gz, summary regeneration (byte-identical), round-46 identity of the v1 calibration outputs, compiled and tool mutants, and the full test gates at the exact head

limits: Renderer-domain data only (OpenCV synthetic and Blender Cycles); one label design, two colour families, one Blender family
The catch threshold is only as good as the stated requirement (DeltaE00 4 in chromatic directions); DeltaE 2 sits at the threshold and lightness changes are out of scope
The reference must be a printed neutral region visible in every object; a clipped reference abstains
A diagonal model on sRGB-decoded values without camera characterization; the linear model is first-order and extrapolates
Blender cells have 4 same-colour objects each
